Five steps. Five decisions.

Work passes through five steps from idea to deployment. In each of them, you decide.

Bellows

01 / 06ResearchModule

Bellows

A person always decides on an idea.

  1. 01

    Citations checked at the source.

    Every claim leads to the source it comes from.

  2. 02

    A decision with a reason.

    Accept, watch, or reject. An accepted idea is exported as a spec for Anvil.

  • Every claim has a source.
  • Zero opportunities is a valid result.

Anvil

02 / 06SpecModule

Anvil

It changes a spec only with your consent.

  1. 01

    Questions with a recommendation.

    You pick the recommended answer or another one, write your own, or talk the unclear point through with Anvil.

  2. 02

    Changes with your consent.

    You see the new wording first, and Anvil writes it only after you confirm.

  • A question for every unclear point.
  • Anvil doesn’t write code or start tasks.

Forge

03 / 06BuildCore

Forge

Nothing is merged without approval.

  1. 01

    A plan for approval.

    Forge breaks down the approach and waits for your approval.

  2. 02

    Code review.

    It addresses the review comments and verifies the fixes again.

  • Approve on a phone too.
  • A fix or a whole backlog.
  • Documentation keeps pace.

Temper

04 / 06VerifyModule

Temper

People approve visual changes.

  1. 01

    A screenshot per step.

    The run ends with a clear verdict.

  2. 02

    A person approves visual snapshots.

    A new page look takes effect only once someone confirms it.

  • A screenshot per step.
  • Credentials don’t belong in a scenario.

Rivet

05 / 06DeployModule

Rivet

Production needs a second confirmation.

  1. 01

    Approval.

    Production needs a second confirmation.

  2. 02

    Deploy and verify.

    The result is recorded only after the real environment is checked.

  • An uncertain result is not passed off as a success.
  • Two deployments to the same environment never run at once.

Harness

06 / 06FoundationModule

Cognera Harness

Recommends the right agent for each task.

  1. 01

    A recommendation with a reason.

    Harness picks an agent and a quality level, and says why.

  2. 02

    Checking the result.

    The result is verified before the work continues.

  • You can always pick the agent yourself.
  • Every decision can be explained afterward.

Common questions

01What is an AI software factory?

Forge is the AI software factory from Cognera. It takes a spec to finished, verified code. Its modules add research, specs, verification, and deployment.

02Who decides what gets merged and deployed?

Always a person. Nothing is merged without approval, and a person merges the changes. A production deployment needs a second confirmation.

03What does Forge do on its own, and where does it wait for me?

It turns the spec into a plan, writes the code and the tests, and checks its own work. Where a decision is needed, it waits for you.

04What if the spec is unclear?

Anvil reads the spec and compares it with the actual code of the project. Where something is missing or the spec contradicts itself, it asks a question and offers an answer. It changes the spec only with your consent.

05How do we know the finished app works?

Temper goes through it like a person, click by click in a real browser, and takes a screenshot at every step. People approve visual changes.

06How does deployment work?

Rivet deploys only what passed verification and what a person approved. A deployment is done only once Rivet has also checked the live environment. An uncertain result is not passed off as a success.

07How do you tell what is worth building?

Bellows looks for what’s worth building and backs ideas with verified sources. When it finds nothing, it says so plainly. A person always decides on an idea.

08Who is behind Forge?

Cognera. Forge was made in our workshop, and we use it for our own work.
